claim: TASK-019 adds transactional authored Design package revision with existing VerifiedDesignPackage/read_verified reuse and explicit MCP read annotation; TASK-020 cuts Designer/bootstrap to create-read-revise package authority; TASK-015..018 remain exact keeps in chain TASK-019 -> TASK-020 -> TASK-015 -> TASK-016 -> TASK-017 -> TASK-018.
evidence: TASK-019 reuses the existing public VerifiedDesignPackage and DesignPackageStore.read_verified as the sole owner of verified bytes, parsed manifest, and owner-computed package identity.
read_design_session exposes the CAS token needed on resume while TASK-020 forbids Designer-side hashing and package-file mutation.

read_design_session is explicitly classified in _DELIVERY_READS with readOnlyHint=true; revise_design_session remains mutating with readOnlyHint=false, proved at the assembled registered-tool boundary.

Existing package verification, replacement transaction participants, guarded expected content, and recovery stages support the specified CAS and old-or-new consistency semantics without a new transaction primitive.
Existing strict 64-hex models and typed DesignPackageConflictError mapping support adapter validation and retry-safe stale-identity diagnostics without adapter-owned conflict logic.
Rulings account for each superseded task: TASK-014 is replaced by TASK-019/TASK-020 and TASK-015..018 are republished unchanged.
Dependencies, path closure, maintained failure injection, and assembled MCP proof are complete and bounded.
